scores.rationale: Named online options have a concrete weekly workload and asynchronous format relevant to preserving regular family time. The generic cap limits the score to 6.

Scheduling flexibility provides an implicit distinction from more demanding routes, but the report does not explicitly compare options in terms of preserving family time versus consuming evenings and weekends.
